# YIELD MGMT Consulting

> Leadership development and organizational consulting for small and mid-size growth tech companies in Israel, founded by Yaniv Cherkasky (25 years in tech). Works in Hebrew and English, in person and remotely.

## Services
- Manager development: workshops and 1:1 programs, from first-line managers to executives.
- Organizational consulting and process improvement: research, root cause analysis, execution with milestones, KPIs and ROI.
- AI tools (such as Anthropic Claude and Microsoft Copilot) for organizational knowledge management and automation.
